reason: The text does not depict priests. The passage focuses on Moses, Aaron (presented as a prophet/spokesman and miracle-worker), and Egyptian magicians/wise men (חַרְטֻמִים - hartumim). While Aaron is portrayed positively as obedient and capable, he is not presented in a priestly role in this narrative. The formal Levitical priesthood had not yet been established in the chronological frame of Exodus 1-6. The Egyptian magicians are not priests but sorcerers/wise men, and they are depicted negatively as opponents to God's will.
